blocking_policy: Every automatic check and every human check must pass before view-pack approval.

human_checks.label: same facial identity in all seven views
long straight black hair with exactly one narrow deep-red front lock
the deep-red front lock remains on character-left in every view and is never mirrored
cropped charcoal combat jacket with deep-red inner lining, fitted black high-neck top, tapered charcoal combat trousers, knee pads and flat black combat boots remain consistent
exactly one sheathed katana is present and it is never duplicated, drawn or supplemented by a second weapon
body proportions and clothing layers remain consistent
clean anime line art and restrained two-step cel shading remain consistent in all seven views
charcoal, black, muted gray, deep red and amber palette remain consistent; eyes stay amber
neutral studio background with a soft gradient and neutral lighting remain consistent; no street scene or dramatic lighting
no mask, visor, eyewear, cape or firearm appears in any view
no extra person, duplicate body, collage, text or watermark
back view contains no visible face or looking-back pose
both profile views are true side views (single eye line, nose at the silhouette, no visible far cheek), not three-quarter views
